subject: QBR readiness: roadmap pulse, timeline compression, contingency asks
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Diane Park <diane@acmecorp.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 08:32:00 -07:00
Subject: QBR readiness: roadmap pulse, timeline compression, contingency asks

Team and Diane —

We’re two weeks from the QBR and I want a concise leadership-level snapshot of where product & engineering stand on the launches we plan to highlight. Specifically:

- Current launch timelines versus go/no-go windows (call out any schedule compression).
- Top delivery risks by feature and a short probability x impact note.
- Mitigations we can commit to before the QBR and what needs executive visibility.

Monica: please attach the latest roadmap heatmap and a one-slide summary of any scope trades you’re considering.
Laura: flag any cross-org dependencies that should appear on the QBR risk slide (security, infra, legal).
Karthik: quick note on test coverage and any remaining platform-level blockers.
Diane: I know Acme is tracking the release cadence; if you have any stakeholder asks to surface to execs, add them into your reply.

Deliverable: one consolidated QBR-ready slide deck (3-5 slides) and a 200-word exec note by EOD Thursday (Sep 3). If we can’t hit that, call out exactly which items will be incomplete and when we expect closure.

Thanks — Vivek
--
Vivek Kulkarni
VP Product & Strategy
Redwood Inference

-----Original Message-----
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Diane Park <diane@acmecorp.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 10:14:23 -07:00
Subject: Re: QBR readiness: roadmap pulse, timeline compression, contingency asks

Vivek — attaching the heatmap and the compressed-timeline CSV (see attachments). Notes below: 

- Roadmap pulse: most feature work is in integration phase. Three items are at risk of slipping if current test cycles don’t complete by Sep 10: Live A/B routing, KV-cache priming for long contexts, and quantized fp16 profile for the 13B variant.
- Timeline compression: to hit the QBR narrative we compressed two minor feature launches into a single milestone; that adds ~1.5 weeks of verification work on infra.
- Top mitigations I recommend: freeze non-critical UI changes today, accelerate an additional smoke cycle next Tue/Wed, and apply a limited canary (5% traffic) to validate performance for KV-cache changes.

Open blockers and owners: 
- KV cache priming: Engineering (Karthik) — intermittent OOMs on 48-token prefix during stress tests.
- A/B routing metrics pipeline: Data infra (Laura) — missing end-to-end test harness for request-level metrics.
- Quantized model perf variance: Research — need one additional calibration run.

I’ve attached: QBR-roadmap-heatmap-v2.pptx, launch-timeline-compression.csv. I will push a one-slide exec summary into the DRIVE link by EOD Wed.

—Monica
Product Ops

-----Original Message-----
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Diane Park <diane@acmecorp.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Sep 2026 09:07:41 -07:00
Subject: Re: QBR readiness: roadmap pulse, timeline compression, contingency asks

Quick infra note:
- Staging cluster capacity is within 10% of our expected peak for the canary tests; ops@falken.io confirmed they can spin an extra node pool but we need a cost approval from finance (I’ve looped them separately).
- For the metrics pipeline, we have a short-term workaround (shadow traffic to our ingestion endpoint) but it won’t show end-to-end consumer latency. If the A/B routing story is prominent in the QBR, we should call out that final latency numbers are pending the test harness.

Also, can we make the deck explicit about which numbers are pre-canary vs post-canary? Audience will assume production-level metrics otherwise.

Laura
Director, Infrastructure

-----Original Message-----
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Diane Park <diane@acmecorp.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Sep 2026 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: QBR readiness: roadmap pulse, timeline compression, contingency asks

Status from engineering: 
- KV-cache OOM: root cause is a KV misindex under heavy concurrency; we have a patch that reduces peak memory by ~18% (benchmarks attached). Patch is code-complete; testing into staging tomorrow. If staging passes, we can schedule a limited canary on Sep 8. Risk: medium probability, high impact (could require rollbacks if cache state corrupts).
- A/B routing: integration tests currently fail on the metric tag propagation; ETA for fix is 48 hours. End-to-end tests scheduled for Sep 7.
- Test coverage: we still have ~12% uncovered codepaths in the long-context execution handler; that’s in our sprint but likely not closed before Sep 10. We’ll mitigate by adding focused tests and a manual verification checklist (infra-ready checklist link).

I’ve uploaded the test artifacts and the benchmark CSV to the DRIVE link (see related links).

—Karthik
Sr. Engineering Manager

-----Original Message-----
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Diane Park <diane@acmecorp.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Sep 2026 21:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: QBR readiness: roadmap pulse, timeline compression, contingency asks

Thanks all — helpful notes. Short summary for the QBR deck: 

- Call out three risk lanes: Platform stability (KV cache), Metrics completeness (A/B routing), and Perf calibration (quantized 13B). For each lane we will show current state, mitigation, and expected date for closure.
- Decision: freeze UI polish; allow infra and backend teams to prioritize stabilizing canary paths.
- Owner commitments: Karthik will validate the KV patch in staging by Sep 4 and signal a Sep 8 limited canary. Laura will confirm extra node pool provisioning and get temporary cost approval by Sep 4. Monica will draft the 3-slide QBR narrative + one-page exec note by EOD Sep 3 and put all artifacts into the DRIVE link.

If any owner cannot meet the dates above, escalate to me immediately with an explicit rollback or narrative change recommendation. Diane — appreciate any customer-facing caveats you want us to surface to avoid surprises.

Vivek

Attachments: QBR-roadmap-heatmap-v2.pptx, launch-timeline-compression.csv, infra-readiness-checklist.pdf
